title: Webb County Commissioners to Weigh $400,000 Veterans Grant, Air-to-Water Machines on Monday
excerpt: Webb County commissioners meet Monday, Nov. 23, at 9 a.m. to consider a state grant of up to $400,000 for the veterans treatment program, air-to-water machines for colonias, and a Medical Examiner tracking system.
content:
Webb County commissioners will meet at 9 a.m. Monday, Nov. 23, at the Webb County Courthouse to take up several items affecting county residents.

Commissioners will first consider applying for a state grant of up to $400,000 to expand the county’s veterans treatment program. The grant requires no county match.

They will then decide whether to seek vendors for machines that produce drinking water from the air. The machines would serve colonias along State Highway 59 and in South Laredo.

The Medical Examiner’s Office is also requesting a system to track the deceased. The system would cost nearly $13,000 a year.

Source: Webb County Commissioners Court agenda, Nov. 22, 2026.

Webb Watch 956
